statement: Outcome and environment concepts per category as stored in the live knowledge store on 2026-10-20 (category_items, concept_kind outcome or environment). All are proposed_unverified teaching (assistant_authored_unreviewed); used here only as the annotation vocabulary.

air_purifiers.description: Lower airborne pollen, dust and pet-dander particles.
Requested health endpoint (fewer infections, asthma attacks, symptoms) — needs clinical evidence, not CADR.
Lower indoor fine particles and smoke (PM2.5, traffic, wildfire, cooking aerosol).
Remove specific gases, VOCs and odours.
Low total running cost, energy use, filter cost and waste.
Adequate cleaning at a noise level tolerable during sleep.
Clean air delivered to the actual occupied room(s) and zones.
Cooking fumes and NO2 from a gas hob need a ducted extractor venting outdoors.
Damp or visible mould needs the moisture source fixed and remediation (dehumidifiers are a separate category); a purifier does not fix it.
Remove or reduce the emission source (smoking, paint, sprays, new furniture) first.
Stuffy air or high CO2 needs outdoor-air ventilation, not recirculating filtration; buying may be unnecessary.

coffee_machines.description: Make coffee with little effort, skill or attention.
Make espresso-based drinks with good taste and little effort.
Get reliable, repeatable coffee with low routine maintenance.
Relevant outcomes: brew temperature accuracy and stability, shot-to-shot consistency, extraction yield or TDS where measured, milk texture, warm-up time and noise.
Make enough coffee for several people or an office.
Already owns a moka pot or another brewer that may meet the need, so buying may be unnecessary.
Ongoing costs (beans versus capsules, filters, descaler), counter space and whether a separate grinder is needed constrain the choice.

coffee_grinders.description: Grind coffee to an even particle size.
Grind away from home: travel, camping or work.

dishwashers.description: Food-soil removal (washing) to a defined endpoint, by soil type and dish material.
Drying endpoint per material (ceramic, glass, steel, plastic) and towel time.
Electricity per programme cycle and per completed household workload.
Verified sanitisation of a specific certified cycle (distinct from cleaning and sterilising).
Noise: label sound power vs in-room sound pressure and transient events (pump, beeps).
Usable capacity: which real plates, bowls, pots and trays physically fit with spray clearance.
Water per cycle and per completed workload, incl. pre-rinse and handwash leftovers.
Cannot plumb an inlet or must not drill (renting): a tank-fed or countertop unit with reversible connections may fit, only if a lawful drain route exists.
A small workload (a few cups or plates) may be met by efficient handwashing, so buying may be unnecessary.

dehumidifiers.description: Use little electricity for the moisture removed.
Remove enough moisture to keep the room at a safe humidity.
Will run in a cold room, where removal and defrost differ from warm test points.
There may be a leak, rain penetration or structural damp: repair and ventilation come before any appliance.
